votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer Items B-1 through B-3 (FY2023 Paul Coverdell Forensic Science Improvement Grant, UDOT Improvements to State Street Grant, and Assistance to Firefighters Submission Grant) to a future Consent Agenda for action.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on three grant applications from the Police Department, Transportation Department, and Fire Department, and refers them to a future consent agenda for formal action.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 20 of 2024, for a temporary road closure of 7200 West between Interstate 80 and California Avenue.
votes.description: Adopts an ordinance temporarily closing a segment of 7200 West between I-80 and California Avenue to mitigate unsafe conditions caused by recurring illegal dumping activity, permitted for up to two years under state law.

votes.motion: Adopt the Ordinance for a Rezone at 2260, and 2290 East 1300 South.
votes.description: Proposed ordinance to rezone properties at 2260 and 2290 East 1300 South from R-1/7,000 to CB (Community Business District); the motion failed due to concerns about lack of affordable housing commitments from the developer.

votes.motion: Reject the Ordinance for a Rezone at 2260, and 2290 East 1300 South.
votes.description: Formally rejects the proposed rezone of properties at 2260 and 2290 East 1300 South from R-1/7,000 to CB, citing the developer's unwillingness to include affordable housing.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 11 of 2024 Northpoint Area Annexation Initiation.
votes.description: Adopts a resolution initiating the annexation process for unincorporated Salt Lake County land along 2200 West in the Northpoint community area; final annexation approval and zoning designation will come back to the Council after a public process.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 21 of 2024 approving a $350,000 loan for Parea, LLC, from the Economic Development Loan Fund.
votes.description: Approves a $350,000 Economic Development Loan Fund loan to Parea, LLC, a new Greek restaurant/market at 320 East 900 South, intended to create 15 new jobs and retain 30 existing jobs.

votes.motion: Approve all items of the Consent agenda other than item G3.
votes.description: Approves consent agenda items including setting public hearing dates for several ordinances and a board appointment for Fraser Nelson to the Housing Authority of Salt Lake, excluding the Ballpark Station Area Rezone item.

votes.motion: Approve item G3 of the Consent agenda (Ordinance: Ballpark Station Area Rezone and Text Amendments – set public hearing date).
votes.description: Approves setting the public hearing date of May 7, 2024 for the Ballpark Station Area Rezone and Text Amendments, which would establish the new MU-8 zoning district and rezone properties in the Ballpark Station Area.
